The '''portmaster''' of [[Esseles starport]] was the original owner of the [[LE-series repair droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]]. The [[Portmaster/Legends|portmaster]] used LE-BO2D9 to ensure that [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] were following [[Starship/Legends|starship]] safety regulations.
